about_the_game:
Welcome to SQUISH Units, a chaotic survival-puzzle game where your only goal is simple: don’t die. Trapped in a mysterious arena, you must collect food, dodge deadly hazards, and outsmart your environment in order to survive just one more cycle. But you're not alone—others are trying to squish, sabotage, and outlast you too [multiplayer coming soon].

Rebuild your crashed ship, navigate randomized layouts, and adapt fast as the world reshapes itself around you. Every run is different, and every mistake could be your last. [ship placeholders are in game as "depots", random layouts coming soon but random food is implamented]

Features:

  • 💥 Fast-paced puzzle-survival gameplay

  • 🧠 Strategic food management and movement planning

  • 🛠️ Ship repair mechanics with real-time risk [mechanics implemented, placeholders in game]

  • 🎮 Unique units with special quirks and abilities [coming soon]

  • 🔁 Replayable runs with randomized chaos [coming soon]

Think quick. Move smarter. Don’t get squished.
